title: An Idiograph project file, <project root>/idiograph-project.json
description: The project's own settings, written by Settings, Projects, his order of its rows, written by a drag on the home screen, how its PETs are labelled, written by PET labels under Export on the PETs screen or in Settings, Projects, how its timecodes are written, and the new names Rename keeps for cases whose folders it kept. A key beyond these is kept as it is.

uid.description: The project's own id, written at its first send and never changed after, so a shared copy coming back is known as this project's (26 October).

copy_of.description: In a copy opened from a shared file, the project it came from: its name, its id, when it was sent and from which Idiograph, when it was opened, and the print of each statement sent, by participant and key (21 and 26 October).

names.description: The new pseudonym Rename gave a case whose folder it kept, by the folder's label, its second part never written, one capitalised word each (16 October).

names_key.description: From namesrule (8 November 2026) alone: the random key under which the app's own folder kept this project's list of real names. Since namesui the list is idiograph-names.json in the project's folder, and the key is taken out of this file the first time the list is read.

pet_labels.description: How the Word document, the print view and the PET draft label the PETs: letters, A, A1, A1.1, as Smith, Flowers and Larkin's Box 5.6 letters them, the default when the key is missing, or numbers, PET 1, PET 1a, 1a.1.

timecodes.description: How every timecode of the project is written, on screen, in print, in Word and in the command line's turn lines (28 October): 75:12, the hours folded into the minutes, 1:15:12, the hours once past the hour, the default when the key is missing, or 01:15:12, the hours always. The files and --json keep their own forms.

demographics.description: The participants' demographics' categories in his order (demobuild, 12 November 2026), written by Project settings' Demographics and demographics apply: each a name, its kind, list (one value for each participant, from its values) or words (free words), whether it shows as a pill, its values in order each with its colour, a place in the participants' palette from 0, and export, whether it goes into the participants table and the PETs' pen portrait line, left out to follow show. Each participant's values are kept in their own set under participants, by the category's name.

participants_table.description: How the participants table on the GETs Export card carries the demographics (demobuild): each, a column for each category ticked, or sum, a short table of each one's values counted. A thematic analysis project's sum and an IPA project's each when it is missing.

timepoints.description: A longitudinal project's timepoints in order, written by Settings, Projects, only with two or more (20 October). Each is known by its place, 1 to 10, its label shown where room is short, T1, and its description beside it where there is room, Before the season. With no key the project has one timepoint.
